Taking the time to blend foundation and line up that eyeliner can be more than just a cosmetic routine—it’s a moment of self‑care and intentionality. When you finish feeling “put‑together,” you’re likely carrying that confidence into whatever comes next. But if the ritual feels good, keep it! It’s a small, intentional act that can boost your mood and confidence for the rest of the day. What’s your favorite part of the routine?
